sources.quote: 104 mm tall x 173 mm wide x 54 mm thick
USB端子（側面×２、背面×１）[USB2.0対応] 本体接続端子 ACアダプター接続端子 HDMI端子
本体接続端子 Nintendo Switch本体をこの中に差し込んで接続します。

notes: The dock sold with the original Nintendo Switch (Nintendo Japan spec modal 'Nintendo Switchドック'; the Singapore English copy of the same modal labels the axes: 104 mm tall x 173 mm wide x 54 mm thick). Axis map: width=173 (横/wide), height=104 (縦/tall), depth=54 (厚さ/thick). Whole millimetres as printed. Neither page says whether projecting parts are excluded: excludes_projections null.

ports is Nintendo's complete connection list for this dock. Nintendo does not name the USB connector type (only 'USB2.0対応'), so the kind is the generic 'usb'; the AC adapter port is recorded as power_in and the console plug as system_connector (neither has a contract kind). The rear-cover hinge and cable cover are not dimensioned.

model_numbers not filed: no Nintendo page read prints the dock's model code. host_console is the proposed catalog key for the HAC-001 console; align with the handheld lane's key at landing. The dock with LAN port (OLED-model dock) is its own object, nintendo-switch-dock-with-lan-port.
